title: $15 IGA Cash for New IGA Rewards Members @ IGA (Excl. TAS)
body:
Deal: $15 IGA Cash for New IGA Rewards Members @ IGA (Excl. TAS)

[user27] not receiving the sms code for some reason
[iamjk] Just tried and the SMS code received without any drama. Signed in via Android app.
[Craze] Doesn't include Ritchie's IGA locations, just regular IGA.
[Tomato] i applied for a catd from a certain branch but cannot be used at a different branch, can only be used at the same IGA branch, not flexible.
[INFIDEL] Why? IGA Rewards Cards are a totally different system, associated with a particular IGA store.
I've had several for so many years, including one for a store in a different State.
This online Rewards system launched recently is much more flexible, & unrelated to the old Rewards Card system!
Scanning on one system does not earn rewards on the other!!
Need to apply online.
[DoubleWookie] Individual stores/groups have had their own rewards programs for a long time. This is different program that is a national one that works across all stores that have signed up for it.
[silverham] How do the accumulate the extra $5 so $15 + $5 = $20 ? Do you only get a couple cents rewards for every IGA purchase?
[DoubleWookie] You get cashback offers on certain products. The app shows you want the current products with an offer are and how much cashback you get for each of them. This deal has links to two different examples at the bottom.
[DH] Like this week in WA, some stores have Bens Rice packets for $1.70 but with $2 cashback, so they pay you 30c to buy them (up to 10 packets) + your $15 from this code.
Few weeks ago I got big bags of brand name rice for $4, brand name pasta sauce for 50c, brand name coffee sticks for negative 50c
[Mokr] Too complicated to get the reward
Regret signing up
[DH] It actually isn't, just scan the card when you are buying stuff,
If you don't know what stuff to buy, go the offers tab, choose your store, then the item and it shows the exact barcodes it applies. Then you wait a few days for confirmation - once you have $20 of cashback it moves to the Visa Card in your wallet.
[Mokr] It says you get 15 dollars in title
Not buy 500 dollars worth of goods to get 16
